checks.notes: The public case projector is allowlisted, prohibited records return 404, the Method route settles correctly, and 297 tests pass on both supported Python versions.

findings.expected: Every case gives a distinct, plain-language reason it matters after the full source summary, without inventing claims.
findings.observed: Forty-eight of 60 public case routes render the visual thesis byte-for-byte after the identical full case summary.
findings.summary: Most case routes repeat their summary instead of explaining why the case matters.

findings.expected: The wide catalog error state keeps its recovery and evidence-boundary text readable at the approved viewport.
findings.observed: The three-column results header forces one paragraph into an extremely narrow column and stretches the other into a long, low-legibility line.
findings.summary: The wide catalog error header is technically bounded but not readable.

results.notes: The deployable case tree now uses exact public field and file allowlists. Internal review records, source notes, metadata, coverage, preview records, request status, response hashes, redirect details, and source-inspection fields are absent.
Fresh direct Method loads settle at methodTop 0 after catalog, page-load, and font layout at all three approved widths.
